payload.title: Numerical global-optimum comparison and quantum-table reproduction
payload.uniqueness_scan: At objective gap 1e-7, largest coordinate range was approximately 0.00299; uniqueness was unresolved at this stage.
payload.quantum_table: One maximally entangled two-qubit binary-output CHSH table, with Alice angles 0 and pi/2 and Bob angles pi/4 and -pi/4.
payload.caveat: Quantum-table result was a feasibility LP, not MI minimization. It does not establish all quantum correlations, arbitrary settings/outcomes, or a physical mechanism.
